summary: HumanPlay-3 UI, main menu, pause menu, Canvas HUD, and RTS camera setup completed with Unity compile and play-mode smoke checks.

checks.name: MainMenu opens
checks.evidence: Assets/Scenes/MainMenu.unity created and play-mode Canvas builds without errors.

checks.name: Start Demo loads HumanPlay_Demo_PlayerVsAI
checks.evidence: SceneFlowController loads HumanPlay_Demo_PlayerVsAI by build-settings scene name; both scenes are enabled in build settings.

checks.name: Demo scene shows Canvas HUD, not huge OnGUI overlay
checks.evidence: HumanPlayCanvas added; HumanPlayHudController disabled; GameSpeed overlay disabled.

checks.name: Start AI vs Player2 works
checks.evidence: HUD button calls HumanPlayModeController.StartAIvsPlayer2; manual click-through not executed in automated smoke.

checks.name: Player2 remains human/manual side
checks.evidence: HumanPlayModeController initial mode set to AIvsPlayer2; HUD uses existing HumanPlayerController/PlayerCommandController.

checks.name: Player1 remains AI side
checks.evidence: AIvsPlayer2 mode uses Player1 AI and Player2 Idle/manual path.

checks.name: UI does not cover most of the screen
checks.evidence: HUD uses top bar, bottom command area, hidden metrics, and modal pause only.

checks.name: F1 hides/shows HUD
checks.evidence: HumanPlayCanvasController handles F1 through PanelVisibilityController.

checks.name: F2 hides/shows metrics
checks.evidence: HumanPlayCanvasController handles F2; MetricsPanel hidden by default.

checks.name: F3 hides/shows selection panel
checks.evidence: HumanPlayCanvasController handles F3.

checks.name: F4 hides/shows production panel
checks.evidence: HumanPlayCanvasController handles F4.

checks.name: Esc opens pause menu
checks.evidence: HumanPlayCanvasController handles Escape and calls GameSpeedController.Pause.

checks.name: Space pauses/resumes
checks.evidence: Existing GameSpeedController Space path preserved.

checks.name: Restart works
checks.evidence: Pause menu calls HumanPlayModeController.RestartMatch, with scene reload fallback.

checks.name: Main Menu button returns to MainMenu
checks.evidence: Pause/HUD buttons call SceneFlowController.LoadMainMenu.

checks.name: Camera is isometric
checks.evidence: Main Camera rotation is X 58, Y 45 and orthographic.

checks.name: WASD moves camera
checks.evidence: RtsCameraController reads WASD via New Input System when available.

checks.name: Mouse wheel zooms
checks.evidence: RtsCameraController reads Mouse.current.scroll and clamps orthographic size.

checks.name: Week7 baseline remains untouched
checks.evidence: Assets/Scenes/Week7_MLAgents_StudentVsScriptedBot.unity not modified.

checks.name: No new C# errors
checks.evidence: Unity console error check returned zero C# errors after compile and play-mode smoke.

checks.name: No New Input System legacy warnings
checks.evidence: No legacy input warnings observed in smoke checks.

checks.name: No Python/training/checkpoint files changed
checks.evidence: This stage only edited Assets presentation/UI/camera files, scenes, prefab, and build settings; pre-existing dirty python files were not touched.

checks.name: No ActionDecoder/ActionApplier semantic changes
checks.evidence: ActionDecoder and ActionApplier were not edited.
